column1: # Whole-tree coverage baseline: per-file line coverage for the first-party sources in
# tests/all-sources.txt, measured 2026-09-11 from a real Debug + WANT_COVERAGE=ON build
# (build-cov in the zene-cov worktree) with the full ctest suite run first (24/24).
# Used by: bash tests/coverage-gate.sh <whole-tree tracefile> tests/coverage-baseline-all.tsv [--check]
# Regenerate: run tests/whole-tree-coverage.sh (capture + filter + summary), then
# Scope note: 919 of the 1,095 first-party files carry instrumentation in this
# configuration. Files with no record (features gated off, declaration-only headers)
# are absent by construction, so the ratchet gates the 919 it can see.
